source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.7, printed pages 114-119.

blocks.text: Lipids non-polar molecules ka ek dheela sa tay kiya hua group hain. Yeh pani mein hal nahin hote magar organic solvents (jaise ether, alcohol waghaira) mein hal ho jate hain. Yeh bohat mukhtalif qisam ke molecules hain aur inhein acylglycerols, waxes, phospholipids, terpenes, steroids aur prostaglandins mein baanta jata hai.
